### Century Complete Announces New Homes Coming to Clinton, SC in November at Shell Creek Manor


November 2, 2026


Single-family homes from the mid $200s offer up to 5 bedrooms and 2,180 square feet, with quartz countertops included and easy access to I-26


**KEY TAKEAWAYS**


- **New construction homes in Clinton:** Century Complete is planning 139 single-family homesites at Shell Creek Manor, with homes starting from the mid $200s.
- **Flexible floor plans:** Five single-family floor plans from 1,290 to 2,180 square feet, with 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 3 bathrooms and 2-car garages.
- **Built-in style:** Every home at Shell Creek Manor features an open-concept layout with stylish features like quartz countertops and luxury vinyl-plank flooring.
- **Convenient location:** Shell Creek Manor offers easy access to Interstate 26 and boasts efficient commutes to Spartanburg, Greenville, and Columbia.
- **Virtual Insider Event:** This 30-minute online event is planned for Monday, Nov. 9 at 5:30 p.m. Attendees will find out more about homesite releases and Grand Opening incentives.
- **Upcoming Grand Opening Event** : Shell Creek Manor is slated to open for sales online on Nov. 12 at 10 a.m., followed by a Grand Opening event on Nov. 14 at 11 a.m.


CLINTON, S.C.


, Nov. 2, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—announced that Shell Creek Manor, a new community from the Company's Century Complete brand, is coming soon to Clinton, S.C., with single-family homes starting from the mid $200s. Interested homebuyers are invited to attend a Virtual Insider Event on Nov. 9 at 5:30 p.m., as well as the Grand Opening event on Nov. 14 at 11 a.m.


**Learn more about Shell Creek Manor and join the interest list at**[www.CenturyCommunities.com/ShellCreekManorSC](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812440-1&h=3717641485&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2FShellCreekManorSC&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FShellCreekManorSC) **.**


**Register for the Virtual Insider Event at** **[www.CenturyCommunities.com/ShellCreekManorInsider](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812440-1&h=1301483345&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.CenturyCommunities.com%2FShellCreekManorInsider&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FShellCreekManorInsider)** **.**


**RSVP for the Grand Opening at**[www.CenturyCommunities.com/ShellCreekGO](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812440-1&h=2841129000&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2FShellCreekGO&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FShellCreekGO) **.**


"Shell Creek Manor gives Clinton homebuyers more home for their budget, with versatile floor plans offering up to 5 bedrooms from the mid $200s," said Regional President Cliff Niederpruem. "The community also offers easy access to regional employment and entertainment hubs, making it a desirable choice for commuters. We encourage interested homebuyers to join our interest list for early updates as homes become available."


Shell Creek Manor will offer five single-family floor plans. Select plans will include features such as main-floor bedrooms and bathrooms, gamerooms, and flex rooms. Every home is designed with an open-concept layout, along with modern included features like quartz countertops and luxury vinyl-plank flooring.


**SHELL CREEK MANOR | CLINTON, SC** *Grand Opening Event on November 14 | From the Mid $200s*


- 139 single-family homesites
- Five floor plans from 1,290 to 2,180 square feet
- 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 3 bathrooms, 2-car garages
- One- and two-story options with open-concept layouts
- Standard quartz countertops and luxury vinyl-plank flooring
- Easy access to I-26, Spartanburg, Greenville, and Columbia

**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS**


**Question:** Where is Shell Creek Manor located?
**Answer:** Shell Creek Manor is a Century Complete community located at Highway 76 E. and Sunset Boulevard in Clinton, SC 29325.


**Question:** How many homesites are planned at Shell Creek Manor in Clinton, SC?
**Answer:** 139 single-family homesites are planned at Shell Creek Manor.


**Question:** What is the starting price for new homes at Shell Creek Manor in Clinton, SC?
**Answer:** New single-family homes at Shell Creek Manor start from the mid $200s.


**Question:** What floor plans are available at Shell Creek Manor in Clinton, SC?
**Answer:** Shell Creek Manor offers five single-family floor plans from 1,290 to 2,180 square feet, 3 to 5 bedrooms, and 2 to 3 bathrooms. Each includes a 2-car garage.


**Question:** What is included in every home at Shell Creek Manor in Clinton, SC?
**Answer:** Every home at Shell Creek Manor features quartz countertops, luxury vinyl-plank flooring, and an open-concept layout.


**Question:** Which schools serve Shell Creek Manor in Clinton, SC?
**Answer:** Shell Creek Manor is served by Eastside Elementary School, Bell Street Middle School, and Clinton High School.


**Question:** When will homes be available at Shell Creek Manor in Clinton, SC?
**Answer:** Shell Creek Manor's Grand Opening will take place on Nov. 14 at 11 a.m., with new homes priced from the mid $200s.


**Question:** What is the commute like from Shell Creek Manor in Clinton, SC?
**Answer:** Shell Creek Manor offers easy access to Interstate 26 for commutes to Spartanburg, Greenville and Columbia.
